entry_reference.matching_package_category: Podium Blocked, Levels 1-9, one or two car parks
entry_reference.calculation: RM328,000 × (1 − 8%) = RM301,760 on the listed base-price reference

qualification: RM301,760 is an indicative calculation on the listed base, not a confirmed unit-level or all-in SPA price.
The pricing source describes applicable car-park, upgrade and other components separately; the exact unit configuration and any applicable components must be confirmed before quoting a final total.
The rebate applies to the stated dated package category. This 14 August 2026 snapshot does not establish that the package remains valid after that date.
Do not combine a different floor/category base, rebate tier, car-park allocation or add-on to manufacture a lower figure.
sales_agent_guidance: In Sales Lab, answer a general how-much or starting-price question directly with the approximately RM302k dated indicative base calculation and its short qualifications. Do not require block, floor, facing or exact unit selection before giving this general reference. Do not file a general-price SUPPORT_REQUEST when this snapshot answers the question. For exact current availability, unit-specific parking, package eligibility or all-in price, be clear about what remains unconfirmed and request support only for that specific missing fact. Never describe this dated test snapshot as a currently valid production offer.
